heading: Bookstore

body: Alhamdulillah, Jāmiʿah Islāmiyah Abū Bakr Library is dedicated to promoting Islamic knowledge, education, and research. Our library offers a valuable collection of Islamic books covering a wide range of subjects, including Tafsir, Hadith, Fiqh, Islamic History, Seerah, and various other Islamic sciences.

The library serves as an important resource for students, teachers, Islamic scholars, researchers, and the wider Muslim community, providing opportunities to deepen their understanding of Islam and benefit from authentic Islamic literature.
We hope that this library will continue to serve as a source of knowledge, guidance, and inspiration for generations to come.
message.closing: May Allah Almighty accept this effort and make it a means of spreading beneficial knowledge. Ameen.

pickup: At the masjid office, 2665 Lawrence Avenue East, Scarborough, between 9 am and 7 pm.
payWith: Cash or debit, at the masjid office
note: The books the masjid sells (one posting per edition; prices from the price list 2026/27), shown with their picture, name and price. Each book with an 'id' (lowercase words joined by hyphens, unique; keep it once published, since links use it) has its own page, book.html?id=<id>, which its card opens; there it can be added to the cart. Books are reserved, not bought: the cart (assets/js/cart.js) sends the reader's name, email and books to 'reserveTo', the Google Apps Script web app in tools/reserve/, which records them in the masjid's sheet and emails the reader a receipt; the reader pays and collects at the masjid. Without 'reserveTo' no book can be added to the cart. A print can be reserved only with a price written like $12.00 and without 'soldOut': true, which shows 'Sold out' instead. 'pickup' is how and where reserved books are collected, 'hold' how long they are kept and 'payWith' how they are paid for; each is shown in the cart and the receipt (a TODO is left out of the receipt). The home page shows three rows of books with a photograph: those marked 'featured' first, then the rest in order; bookstore.html shows them all, filtered by year and by group of subjects ('years' is the list of years a book is taught in; a book in two years stands under both). 'subjectGroups' are the groups the page filters by, in order: each a 'name' and the 'subjects' in it; a subject in no group falls into the last. 'size' is 'large' for a card two columns wide and two rows high, in its cover's colour, with its description (left out: a normal card); 'tint' (#rrggbb, optional) is a large card's colour in place of its cover's. 'subject' is the small line above a title and may be empty; 'edition' is the line under it that tells one edition of a book from another, and 'description' is shown on the book's page. 'price' is text, written as it should read ("$12.00"); empty hides it. 'cover' is a photograph's path (ideally 3:4, e.g. assets/img/books/name.jpg); without one the binding named by 'color' is drawn (lapis, ink, lapis-silver, ink-silver, petrol, slate, oxblood or aubergine). A book in several prints has 'prints': [{edition, price, cover, soldOut}], each reserved on its own. Edit with tools/admin_server.py, or by hand. 'message' is the librarian's message, shown on bookstore.html between the masthead and the subjects: 'body' is its paragraphs and 'closing' the du'a centred beneath them (an empty 'body' hides it). It is edited here by hand; the editor keeps it as it is.

books.title: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī
books.author: Imām Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Bukhārī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: The most authentic book after the Book of Allah: Imam al-Bukhari's collection of sound hadith, studied in full in the final year.

books.title: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim
books.author: Imām Muslim ibn al-Ḥajjāj
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: Imam Muslim's collection of authentic hadith, second only to al-Bukhari's and known for its careful arrangement of chains and wordings.

books.title: Sunan Abī Dāwūd
books.author: Imām Abū Dāwūd al-Sijistānī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: Imam Abu Dawud's collection of the hadith on which the rulings of fiqh are based, arranged by the chapters of law.

books.title: Sunan al-Nasāʾī
books.author: Imām Aḥmad ibn Shuʿayb al-Nasāʾī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: Imam al-Nasa'i's Sunan, among the strictest of the collections in its choice of narrators, with special attention to hidden defects in chains.

books.title: Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī
books.author: Imām Abū ʿĪsā al-Tirmidhī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: Imam al-Tirmidhi's collection, which grades each hadith and records how the Companions and jurists acted on it.

books.title: Sunan Ibn Māja
books.author: Imām Ibn Māja al-Qazwīnī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: Imam Ibn Majah's Sunan, the sixth of the six major books of hadith, valued for the many narrations found in it alone.

books.title: Mishkāt al-Maṣābīḥ
books.author: Walī al-Dīn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Khaṭīb al-Tibrīzī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: Al-Khatib al-Tibrizi's expansion of al-Baghawi's Masabih al-Sunnah: about six thousand hadith from the major collections, arranged by subject.

prints.edition: Black and gold, Ashrafi Book Depot

books.title: Muwaṭṭaʾ al-Imām Muḥammad
books.author: Imām Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Shaybānī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: Imam Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Shaybani's narration of the Muwatta', which he heard from Imam Malik, with his own notes on Hanafi positions.

books.title: Muwaṭṭaʾ al-Imām Mālik
books.author: Imām Mālik ibn Anas
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: The earliest surviving book of hadith and law, compiled by Imam Malik, the Imam of Madinah.

books.title: Riyāḍ al-Ṣāliḥīn
books.author: Imām Yaḥyā ibn Sharaf al-Nawawī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: Imam al-Nawawi's much-loved collection of hadith on character, manners, worship and the good life, each chapter opening with verses of the Qur'an.

books.title: Sharḥ Maʿānī al-Āthār
books.author: Imām Abū Jaʿfar al-Ṭaḥāwī
books.subject: Usul Hadith
books.description: Imam al-Tahawi's collection of hadith on legal questions, which brings together narrations that seem to conflict and shows how they fit together.

prints.edition: Black and gold, Ashrafi Book Depot

books.title: Zād al-Ṭālibīn
books.author: Maulānā ʿĀshiq Ilāhī Bulandshahrī
books.subject: Hadith
books.description: A short collection of hadith chosen by Maulana Ashiq Ilahi Bulandshahri, mostly from Mishkat al-Masabih, which gives students their first Arabic hadith to read, translate and memorise.

books.title: Taysīr Muṣṭalaḥ al-Ḥadīth
books.author: Dr Maḥmūd al-Ṭaḥḥān
books.subject: Usul Hadith
books.description: Dr Mahmud al-Tahhan's clear modern introduction to the sciences of hadith: the terms and principles scholars use to judge whether a narration is authentic.

books.title: Al-Fawz al-Kabīr
books.author: Shāh Walī Allāh al-Dihlawī
books.subject: Usul Tafsir
books.description: Shah Waliullah al-Dihlawi's influential short work on the principles of tafsir: what the Qur'an teaches, and how to understand it.

books.title: Tafsīr al-Jalālayn
books.author: Jalāl al-Dīn al-Maḥallī & Jalāl al-Dīn al-Suyūṭī
books.subject: Tafseer
books.description: The concise classic commentary on the whole Qur'an by the two Jalals, al-Mahalli and al-Suyuti, explaining the meaning of every verse in a few words.

books.title: Al-Muqaddima al-Jazariyya
books.author: Imām Shams al-Dīn Ibn al-Jazarī
books.subject: Tajwid
books.description: Imam Ibn al-Jazari's famous poem on tajwid, which gathers the rules of recitation into about a hundred verses that students memorise.

books.title: Al-Fawāʾid al-Makkiyya
books.author: Qārī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Makkī
books.subject: Tajwid
books.description: A classic Urdu manual of tajwid by Qari Abdur Rahman Makki, setting out the rules for reciting the Qur'an correctly.

books.title: Jamāl al-Qurʾān
books.author: Maulānā Ashraf ʿAlī Thānawī
books.subject: Tajwid
books.description: Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanwi's short Urdu treatise on tajwid, which sets out the rules of recitation in brief lessons.

prints.edition: With the Zinat al-Furqan notes, Maktaba Rahmaniyya

books.title: Tajweed Made Easy
books.subject: Tajwid
books.description: A beginner's guide in English to tajwid, the rules for reciting the Qur'an correctly.

books.title: Tajweed for Beginners
books.author: Qārī Ismāʿīl Essack
books.subject: Tajwid
books.description: Qari Ismail Essack's English introduction to tajwid, taking beginners step by step through the rules of reciting the Qur'an.

books.title: Tashīl al-Naḥw
books.author: Aamir Bashir, after Maulānā Mushtāq Aḥmad Charthāwalī
books.subject: Nahwa
books.description: A primer of Arabic grammar (nahw) that sets out the basic rules of the sentence simply, with plenty of exercises.

prints.edition: Jāmiʿah Islāmiyah Abū Bakr edition, maroon cover

books.title: Hidāyat al-Naḥw
books.subject: Nahwa
books.description: A classic textbook of Arabic grammar (nahw) in the Dars-i Nizami, setting out the rules of the noun, the verb and the particle in concise Arabic.

books.title: Āsān Naḥw
books.author: Muftī Saʿīd Aḥmad Pālanpūrī
books.subject: Nahwa
books.description: An Urdu primer of Arabic grammar (nahw) in two short parts, both studied, that explains the basic rules simply and practises them with exercises.

books.title: ʿIlm al-Naḥw
books.author: Maulānā Mushtāq Aḥmad Charthāwalī
books.subject: Nahwa
books.description: Maulana Mushtaq Ahmad Charthawali's Urdu course in Arabic grammar (nahw), setting out the rules of the sentence and its case endings in order.

books.title: Tamrīn al-Naḥw
books.author: Maulānā Sayyid ʿInāyatullāh Nadwī
books.subject: Nahwa
books.description: An Urdu workbook of exercises in Arabic grammar (nahw).

books.title: Kitāb al-Naḥw
books.author: Maulānā Qārī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Amritsarī
books.subject: Nahwa
books.description: TODO: description.

books.title: Tadrīb al-Naḥw
books.author: Sayyid Ẓafar Aḥmad Jamīl Ḥusāmī
books.subject: Nahwa
books.description: TODO: description.

books.title: Tashīl al-Ṣarf
books.subject: Sarf
books.description: A primer of Arabic morphology (sarf): how words are built from their roots and how verbs change their forms.

books.title: ʿIlm al-Ṣarf (Awwalīn)
books.author: Maulānā Mushtāq Aḥmad Charthāwalī
books.subject: Sarf
books.description: The first half of Maulana Mushtaq Ahmad Charthawali's Urdu course in Arabic morphology (sarf): the patterns of the verb and how its forms are made.

books.title: ʿIlm al-Ṣarf (Ākhirīn)
books.author: Maulānā Mushtāq Aḥmad Charthāwalī
books.subject: Sarf
books.description: The second half of Maulana Mushtaq Ahmad Charthawali's course in Arabic morphology (sarf), completing the verb forms and the weak and irregular roots.

books.title: ʿIlm al-Ṣīgha
books.author: Muftī ʿInāyat Aḥmad Kākorawī; in Urdu by Muftī Muḥammad Rafīʿ ʿUthmānī
books.subject: Sarf
books.description: An advanced book of Arabic morphology (sarf), here in Urdu with notes, that takes students through the rarer patterns and the changes in weak and doubled roots.

books.title: Āsān Ṣarf
books.author: Muftī Saʿīd Aḥmad Pālanpūrī
books.subject: Sarf
books.description: Maulana Sa'eed Ahmad Palanpuri's Urdu primer of Arabic morphology (sarf), which sets out the patterns of words simply, with exercises.

books.title: Āsān Ṣarf
books.author: Muftī Saʿīd Aḥmad Pālanpūrī
books.subject: Sarf
books.description: Maulana Sa'eed Ahmad Palanpuri's Urdu primer of Arabic morphology (sarf), which sets out the patterns of words simply, with exercises.

books.title: Durūs al-Balāgha
books.author: Ḥifnī Nāṣif, Muḥammad Diyāb, Sulṭān Muḥammad & Muṣṭafā Ṭamūm
books.subject: Balagha
books.description: A short introduction to Arabic rhetoric (balagha) and its three branches: meaning (ma'ani), imagery (bayan) and ornament (badi').

books.title: Qaṣaṣ al-Nabiyyīn
books.author: Shaykh Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī Nadwī
books.subject: Arabic
books.description: The first part of Shaykh Abul Hasan Ali Nadwi's stories of the prophets, written for young readers in simple, flowing Arabic. Students read real Arabic narrative from their first year.

books.title: Durūs al-Lugha al-ʿArabiyya
books.author: Dr V. ʿAbd al-Raḥīm
books.subject: Arabic
books.description: Dr V. Abdur Rahim's course of the Islamic University of Madinah, studied complete, in all three books. It teaches Arabic through Arabic, one lesson at a time.

books.title: Al-Qirāʾa al-Wāḍiḥa
books.author: Maulānā Waḥīd al-Zamān Kairānawī
books.subject: Arabic
books.description: Maulana Wahid al-Zaman Kairanawi's graded Arabic reader of short, simple passages.

books.title: Taʿlīm al-ʿArabiyya: al-Kitāb al-Asāsī
books.author: Umm al-Qurā University
books.subject: Arabic
books.description: Umm al-Qura University's course in Arabic for those who don't speak it, taught in Arabic.

books.title: Urdū kā Āsān Qāʿida
books.subject: Urdu
books.description: A first primer of Urdu: the letters, their joined forms and simple words, so that beginners learn to read and write Urdu quickly and easily.

books.title: ʿArabī kā Muʿallim
books.author: Maulvī ʿAbd al-Sattār Khān
books.subject: Arabic
books.description: Maulvi Abdus Sattar Khan's Urdu course in the Arabic language, taught through grammar and graded exercises.

books.title: Urdū Khushkhaṭī
books.subject: Urdu
books.description: Practice in Urdu handwriting: students copy the letters, their joined forms and whole words until they write Urdu neatly and clearly.

books.title: Achchhī Bāteṉ
books.author: Ḥakīm Sharāfat Ḥusayn Raḥīmābādī
books.subject: Urdu
books.description: The first Urdu reader of the course. Short lessons on good manners and conduct teach students to read Urdu and give them its basic words and grammar.

books.title: Nūr al-Īḍāḥ
books.author: Imām Ḥasan al-Shurunbulālī
books.subject: Fiqh
books.description: Imam Hasan al-Shurunbulali's short Hanafi text on the fiqh of worship: purity, prayer, zakat, fasting and hajj.

books.title: Mukhtaṣar al-Qudūrī
books.author: Imām Abū al-Ḥusayn al-Qudūrī
books.subject: Fiqh
books.description: Imam al-Quduri's concise text of Hanafi law, from purity to inheritance: the first complete book of fiqh in Arabic that students read.

books.title: Al-Hidāya
books.author: Imām Burhān al-Dīn al-Marghīnānī
books.subject: Fiqh
books.description: Imam al-Marghinani's classic manual of Hanafi law, explaining each ruling together with its evidence. It is studied over two years.

books.title: Al-Fiqh al-Muyassar
books.author: Shafīq al-Raḥmān al-Nadwī
books.subject: Fiqh
books.description: Shafiq al-Rahman al-Nadwi's simplified Hanafi fiqh in Arabic. This part, on worship, covers purity, prayer, zakat, fasting and hajj in short, clear lessons.

books.title: Uṣūl al-Shāshī
books.author: Niẓām al-Dīn al-Shāshī
books.subject: Usul Fiqh
books.description: A short classic of Hanafi legal theory (usul al-fiqh): how rulings are derived from the Qur'an, the Sunnah, consensus and analogy.

books.title: Mabādiʾ al-Uṣūl
books.author: Muftī Saʿīd Aḥmad Pālanpūrī
books.subject: Usul Fiqh
books.description: Mufti Saeed Ahmad Palanpuri's short introduction to the principles of jurisprudence (usul al-fiqh), preparing students for Usul al-Shashi.

books.title: Al-Sirājī
books.author: Sirāj al-Dīn al-Sajāwandī
books.subject: Mirath
books.description: Al-Sirajiyya of Siraj al-Din al-Sajawandi, the classic Hanafi text on inheritance, which works through the heirs, their shares and the harder cases.

books.title: Muʿīn al-Farāʾiḍ
books.author: Muftī Maḥmūd Ḥasan Ajmerī
books.subject: Mirath
books.description: A primer on Islamic inheritance (mirath): who inherits, what share each heir receives, and how an estate is divided.

books.title: Sharḥ al-ʿAqīda al-Ṭaḥāwiyya
books.author: Imām Abū Jaʿfar al-Ṭaḥāwī
books.subject: Aqidah
books.description: A commentary on Imam al-Tahawi's short statement of the beliefs of Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah, accepted across the schools for over a thousand years.

books.title: Matn al-ʿAqīda al-Ṭaḥāwiyya
books.author: Imām Abū Jaʿfar al-Ṭaḥāwī
books.subject: Aqidah
books.description: Imam Abu Ja'far al-Tahawi's short statement of the creed of Ahl al-Sunna, without commentary.

books.title: Nūr al-Yaqīn
books.author: Shaykh Muḥammad al-Khuḍarī Bek
books.subject: Sira
books.description: Shaykh Muhammad al-Khudari's concise biography of the Prophet ﷺ, written in clear and elegant Arabic.

books.title: Taʿlīm al-Ḥaq
books.subject: Islamic Studies
books.description: TODO: description.

books.title: Taʿlīm al-Islām
books.author: Muftī Muḥammad Kifāyatullāh Dehlawī
books.subject: Islamic Studies
books.description: Mufti Kifayatullah Dehlawi's classic primer of the faith in questions and answers: belief, purity, prayer and the other basics every Muslim needs. This edition adds forty hadith and forty sunnah supplications.

books.title: Tārīkh-e-Islām
books.author: Maulānā ʿĀshiq Ilāhī Mīrṭhī
books.subject: History

books.author: Maulānā Muḥammad Ismāʿīl Rayḥān
books.subject: Fikr
books.description: A study of the intellectual challenges facing Muslims today, the ideas that question Islam's teachings, and how to answer them.

books.author: Maulānā Iʿzāz ʿAlī Amrohī
books.subject: Adab
books.description: An anthology of classical Arabic prose by Mawlana I'zaz Ali, with stories, wise sayings and accounts from Arab history, used to train students to read real Arabic literature.
